title: Gustav von Schöning to Princess Wilhelmina and Van der Hoop, 1783-84 (KHA A32-603)

steps.what: Web search for an edition of the Schöning mission letters: none found; not on DECODE.
Fetched the 212 scans of KHA A32-603.
Aligned ~200 signs of the 6 Jan 1784 original with its clear copy: 17 letters confirmed, g/z/doubled-l single sightings, b h j k x y not yet seen; not yet checked on a second pair.
Rest of the 6 Jan 1784 pair aligned at 3x: h, x, z, second s, doubling dot added; table covers all letters used except y.
Table checked on the 25 Nov 1783 letter against its clear copy: 142/143 known signs agree (99.3%); b found.

Code table from the decipherer's glosses on the 25 Nov 1783 copy (38 numbers) and context in 13 clear copies (78 numbers): a one-part alphabetical code with homophone blocks; context values placed by alphabetical bracketing.

11 letters with no clear copy deciphered with the letter and code tables (dec_*.tsv): 3,447 tokens, 92.8% given a value, 80 codes bracketed alphabetically; sense not yet checked line by line; No. 1 only partly transcribed.

Per-line sense check with fr-1600-letters (threshold -2.6): 7 lines flagged and re-read at 3x; G11 settled as c only; No. 1 transcribed in full. 4,100 tokens, 92.2% given a value; 93.1% of letter signs on lines reading as French; without No. 1, 94.6%.

De Larrey's dossier KHA A32-604 searched (442 scans): one 17-entry key list (scan 6, 'Zifferschlussel zwischen den Briefen gefunden', Byland); applied, 11 tokens resolved; 92.4% given a value, 145/228 codes known.
No. 1 weak lines re-read at 5-6x: 89.7% of its tokens given a value (from 81.4%); all letters 93.9%; sense 90.7% of letter signs on lines scoring >= -2.6.
No. 1 lines 3, 4, 6, 15, Nos. 2-3 (dec_003, dec_005), s174 line 1 and s175 line 11 re-read sign by sign at 5-6x by subagents; double counts and a split code bracket removed.

Sibling files A32-599/601/602 and the No. 4 glosses surveyed: Van der Hoop's 'Dechiffrement' of 14 Dec 1783 (A32-599) and glossed copies give about 128 code values (code_values_new.tsv); 43 bracketed tokens filled (apply_values.py).
Measure 3,988/4,088 tokens (97.6%), sense 95.9% of letter signs on lines scoring >= -2.6 (fr-1600-letters); 188 of 226 codes known.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 3784 tokens, 41 types, fr-1600-letters order 4: reading -2.154 per letter; random keys -5.887 (z 5.7); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.241 (mean -3.258, z 112.2); annealer on the real text -2.153. Verdict: pass.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.083; polyphony 0.011; 62 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.153

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The symbol alphabet was rebuilt from the decipherer's clear copies filed with the cipher letters (A32-603), and the code table from their glosses, Van der Hoop's 14 Dec 1783 decipherment and other glossed copies in the sibling files A32-599/602, and De Larrey's Byland key list (A32-604); with them the eleven letters without a clear copy were deciphered.
outcome.notes: 3,988 of 4,088 tokens given a value (97.6%); 95.9% of letter signs on lines that read as French; 188 of 226 code numbers known.

gaps.item: 62 scattered unread signs (No. 1, s172, s175, 27 Jan)
gaps.detail: blots and overwriting by a later hand; re-read at 5-6x

gaps.item: signature formula and s029 address panel
gaps.detail: one fixed short string each, no clear form

texts.label: Schoning to Van der Hoop and the Princess, 1783-84: the eleven letters without a clear copy
texts.summary: Schoning's secret mission at the Prussian court for Princess Wilhelmina: his arrival and the false patriots at Potsdam, Thulemeier 'un infame' and Hertzberg to be sent away, the King's hatred of the Prince and love of the Princess, a plan for a defensive and offensive alliance of the Republic with France, Spain and Prussia against England and the Emperor, his secret channel, and Gaffron's affair at Constantinople.

reading_review.note: The deciphered passages read as French sentences in Schoning's sound-spelling and are translated in reading_en.md; a few stretches of s172 and s175 stay fragmentary and are marked. Not checked by a human against the images.

prior.where: Van der Hoop's decipherments in the same file.

human: Asked to take KHA lead K4.
